podcast.title: Dahle Brothers' Additional Project
podcast.body: Static and Stereo was another band formed by the Dahle brothers, Ryan and Kurt, showcasing their prolific musical collaboration beyond Age of Electric and Limblifter. Its mention implies a level of recognition among listeners. "The doll brothers had another band that you might remember called Static and Stereo."
